name: Startup Inspire

sources.title: Batch-provided URL — Angular SPA shell; site is live and calls api.startupinspire.com
Pricing (via search index) — Free: 1 startup, instant approval, permanent listing; Standard €19 lifetime for 5; Premium €49 lifetime unlimited
FAQ (via search index) — submission asks for business model, target market, value proposition; team reviews each startup
Support page — contact form plus hello@startupinspire.com

requirements: Free tier: submit 1 startup with instant approval and a permanent listing
Paid tiers: Standard €19/lifetime (up to 5 startups), Premium €49/lifetime (unlimited, promo banner, featured homepage header, 30-day boost)
Submission asks for business model, target market, and unique value proposition
Account required — submission flow is behind the dashboard (Google sign-in is wired into the app)
preparation: Account (register or Google sign-in at startupinspire.com)
Startup name, URL, logo/screenshot, description covering business model + target market + value proposition
Decide free vs paid before submitting — paid adds featured placement and promotion
workflow: Fill startup details and submit — free tier reports instant approval
Verify the permanent descriptive page and homepage/category visibility
watchFor: Claims '15,000+ startups submitted' — a high-volume gallery; individual visibility may be thin on the free tier
Paid tiers are lifetime (one-time) fees, not subscriptions
FAQ says submissions are 'reviewed by our team' while pricing says 'Instant Approval' — the free listing likely auto-publishes
Site is JS-rendered; a plain HTTP fetch shows only the app shell — use a real browser flow
countsAsLive: The startup has a public descriptive page on startupinspire.com and appears in the startups gallery/homepage rotation
unknowns: Whether free listings get a followed link to the startup site
Actual editorial review rigor given 'instant approval' on free tier
